title: Strange Printer
goal: Print a string using the fewest turns when one turn paints one character over a contiguous interval.
strategy: Interval DP first considers printing the left character separately. If that character occurs again inside the interval, the same printing turn can cover both occurrences while the intervening interval is repaired separately.
